stem: Which factor promoted the U.S. cattle industry's rapid growth in the 1870s and early 1880s?

options.label: A
options.text: New trade agreements between the government and ranchers in foreign countries

options.label: B
options.text: The construction of railroad lines connecting western ranches to markets in the East

options.label: C
options.text: Food shortages experienced in Northern cities following the end of the Civil War

options.label: D
options.text: A widespread willingness among immigrant groups to sell their land to beef producers
